dataset.title: Greenland glacier terminus time series and variability
notes: CSV contains change-in-area and change-in-length time-series records.
DBF contains glacier ID, satellite, error and observation date attributes.
KML supplies one point coordinate only; it is not a glacier boundary.
The matching .shp geometry file was not supplied, so line geometry cannot be reconstructed from the .shx and .dbf files alone.
Values are preserved as supplied; interpretation of positive/negative signs and error units should follow the official NSIDC documentation.
